items.summary: Fixed the fit check and the cost worksheet: both now load their scripts at the address where the site serves them (tools/<name>/ as well as tools/<name>.html); every button and field was tested in a browser.

Home reworked: current access status (signups open, no new-user credit, API operational; checked 30 Sep 2026, 20:47 UTC), four dated notices, a short answer and direct task paths. The dated 'What changed' list moved to Research.
New page: graded ledger of published Jev benchmarks (A–D with flags; all results Reported), where studies agree and conflict, what is not measured, and TypeSafe's terms on publishing benchmarks.
New page: Jev vs an LLM with JSON output vs a trained classifier, with 10 criteria, published head-to-head results and the Jev-then-LLM pattern; the classifier comparison rests only on grade D rows.
Correction: TypeSafe's rate limits are now 100K tokens per second and 40 requests per second (checked 30 Sep 2026, 20:47 UTC), replacing 250,000 tokens/s and 1,200 requests/min.
Access status rechecked 30 Sep 2026, 20:47 UTC: unchanged; the 29 Sep maintenance and console events were added to the timeline; API uptime 99.828%.
TypeScript page: version-drift note for ai 7.0.124 and @ai-sdk/typesafe-ai 3.0.12 (released 30 Sep, not re-audited).
Official vs reseller: added the typesafe-ai n8n node repository and WorkflowEvals as official surfaces; the npm package publisher was not checked.
Confidence thresholds: corrected the Alex Molas row (it includes one small example) and linked the calibration rows of the benchmarks ledger.
New research report: evaluation evidence and home status, 30 Sep 2026.
New page: Build hub comparing Python, TypeScript, AI SDK, raw HTTP and Claude Code integration paths, with the build steps in order.
New page: failure matrix for six Jev Claude Code, MCP and agent-guard integrations read in source; only LangChain AutoModeMiddleware fails closed and the official plugin makes no Jev call.
New page: calling Jev from TypeScript with @typesafe-ai/sdk 0.6.0, AI SDK experimental_evaluate (ai 7.0.105 or later), fetch or the Workers binding, with 12 gotchas.
New page: 12 ways to test a Jev integration without a key, what each proves, 10 failure branches and a tested offline Node example.
Correction: oh-my-claudecode's 2000 ms Jev timeout is only on its dev branch; the latest release v5.5.0 still defaults to 250 ms (checked 29 Sep).
Correction: the jev-mcp row is now 'jev-mcp (jkudish)', regraded A and advisory; five more audited Claude Code, MCP and agent-guard integrations have graded rows.
Rechecked signup, credit, status page, aliases, prices and SDK versions on 29 Sep: no change; check dates updated.
New research report: integration trust (29 Sep 2026).
Reorganised the catalogue by reader question: rebuilt Home and the Use cases, Alternatives, Products and Where-to-use hubs, extended What is Jev, and kept every earlier URL and report.
New page: Jev API access status with a dated timeline; signups reopened 27 Sep, new-user free credit disabled.
New page: official TypeSafe surfaces, a five-step check and lookalike reseller prices (3–16× list price).
New page and worksheet tool: cost per decision from your own input-token counts, with third-party token measurements.
New page: version-pinned Python example for typesafe-sdk 0.7.2, a tested-offline retry client and 12 gotchas.
New page: documented vs reported error codes, request limits, gateway differences and a fallback procedure.
New page: what Jev's confidence fields mean, a formula check on documented examples, calibration tests and a seven-step cutoff procedure.
New page: 17 limitations TypeSafe documents for Jev 1.13, with workarounds, and the explained fit check.
New page: 46 demo videos in 13 use-case groups, each linked to the creator-marked start of the demo.
Route matrix: Vercel's exact $0.042/M and ZDR none, OpenRouter /api/v1/systemone, new Jev Router row, Opper 64K context.
Products: added a production-claims ledger; relabelled two rows from the unofficial TypeSafeAI community organisation as not TypeSafe official.
